changes: Rolls back 0.1.4: Tape Echo runs the 0.1.3 code again and MIX is a plain dry/wet crossfade once more. The level drop at the default MIX 90 (#607) is back.
Projects set up with 0.1.4 sound different: the dry signal is up to 10.7 dB quieter at MIX 90. Raise the track volume or lower MIX to taste.
Known issue: the Octatrack can freeze with seven Tape Echo instances.
Fixes Tape Echo turning the track down (#607): the dry signal stays at full level up to MIX 95 and fades out above it. Echoes, feedback and tone are unchanged.
Projects saved earlier sound different: the dry signal is up to 10.7 dB louder at MIX 90 and the echoes sit lower. Lower MIX or the track volume to taste.
Stereo echo, also asked for in #607, is not planned: the echo stays mono and the dry signal stays stereo.
On the beta base, picking it no longer shows DSP MEMORY FULL just because the modules named in the bank's Parts do not all fit on one DSP core.
Known issue: not tested on hardware, and the freeze with seven instances is still open.
Media only: adds an audio preview of a Legowelt Juno 106 chord pluck with clean and worn echoes. The firmware is unchanged.
Installs over USB on the Modwerk beta base.
Known issue: the USB version has not yet run on a unit.
Documentation only: adds screenshots of the selection and control pages and how to reach them. The firmware is unchanged.
Documentation only: updates the author credits. The firmware is unchanged.
First Modwerk catalog release of the CPU-based mono tape echo in FX2, with stereo dry output, tape saturation, age and feedback behaviour.
